React elements vs components vs DOM nodes

A component is a definition; a React element describes a renderable instance; a DOM node is the actual
browser object.
Function component එක definition එකයි. JSX එJකන් element description එක හදනවා. Browser DOM
Button component produces an element that React renders to a real button.
Button function <Button /> element React render/commit HTMLButtonElement
Read the diagram: The element is a description, not the browser node itself.
Expected result: The browser displays a native Save button.

Interview question: Is a JSX element a DOM node?
Answer: No. It is a React description of what to render.
